parameters.content:
## ✈️ Flights Price Monitor 

This workflow automatically tracks economy round-trip flight prices from different destinations across different departure dates , posting price updates and alerts to Slack whenever a deal is found or prices change.

**Perfect for:** Travelers or deal-hunters who want hands-free flight price monitoring with instant Slack notifications.

---

## How it works

1. **When clicking 'Execute workflow'** — Manually triggers the workflow for testing or on-demand checks.
2. **Smart Schedule Gate** — Determines the current time zone and run mode: every 10 minutes at night, or once per hour during the day.
3. **Should Run Now?** — Gates execution based on the schedule logic; stops the run if it is not the right time.
4. **Generate dates** — Produces separate items, one for each departure date for given date.
5. **Run an Actor and get dataset** — Calls the Apify Google Flights scraper once per date to fetch live pricing data from Google Flights for given destination.
6. **Extract Cheapest for This Date** — Parses the Apify response, identifies the lowest-priced flight for that date, and extracts airline, flight numbers, times, duration, stops, and booking link.
7. **Collect All  Date Results** — Aggregates all  individual date results into a single item for comparison.
8. **Find Cheapest & Decide** — Compares all dates to find the overall cheapest, builds the full price calendar, computes the price trend against the last run, and determines whether to fire a price-drop alert.
9. **Below given price ?** — Branches on whether the best price found is below the given price target threshold.
10. **price drop Alert** — Sends an urgent Slack alert to the #price-drop channel when the price is below target.
11. **normal update** — Sends a standard status update to the #regular-update channel when no threshold is breached.
12. **all dates full report** — Sends a comprehensive 18-date price calendar report to the #sales-team channel on every run.

---

## Setup (~10 minutes)

1. **Apify OAuth2 API** — Connect your Apify account and confirm access to the Google Flights scraper actor in the *Run an Actor and get dataset* node.
2. **Slack OAuth2 API** — Authenticate your Slack workspace in the *price drop Alert*, *normal update*, and *all dates full report* nodes.
3. **Slack channel IDs** — Verify the channel IDs for #price-drop, #regular-update, and #sales-team are correct in each respective Slack node.
> This workflow uses Apify actor credits on every run across 18 dates. Monitor your Apify usage to avoid unexpected charges.

## 1️⃣ Trigger & Schedule Gate

The **When clicking 'Execute workflow'** node starts the process manually or on a schedule. The **Smart Schedule Gate** code node reads the current time in the America/New_York zone and decides whether the workflow is in nighttime mode (every 10 minutes) or daytime mode (once per hour). The **Should Run Now?** If node enforces this gate, stopping execution immediately if the timing conditions are not met.

## 2️⃣ Date Generation & Flight Scraping

The **Generate dates** code node produces 18 separate output items, one for each departure date from July 1 through July 18, 2026. For each date, **Run an Actor and get dataset** invokes the Apify Google Flights scraper with the PHL to DAC route and a 30-day return window, fetching live price data. The **Extract Cheapest for This Date** code node then parses the raw Apify response to pull out the lowest-priced flight option, its airline, flight numbers, departure and arrival times, duration, stop count, and a direct booking link.

## 3️⃣ Aggregation & Price Decision

The **Collect All 18 Date Results** aggregate node combines all 18 individual date items into a single payload. The **Find Cheapest & Decide** code node then compares every date to identify the overall cheapest flight, builds a full 18-date price calendar with 🔥 and 👑 markers, computes the price trend against the previous run using persistent static data, and sets a flag for whether the price is below the $1,400 target. The **Below $1,400?** If node branches the flow depending on whether that threshold has been crossed.

## 4️⃣ Slack Notifications

Three Slack nodes handle outbound messaging to different audiences. The **price drop Alert** node fires only when the price is below $1,400, sending a high-priority alert with full flight details to the #price-drop channel. The **normal update** node posts a standard status summary to the #regular-update channel when no threshold is breached. The **all dates full report** node sends a comprehensive 18-date price calendar to the #sales-team channel on every successful run, regardless of price level.
